trust_boundary: ordinary Penpot code window receiving a W0-issued W3 capsule and bounded tickets out of band
guarantees: nonce replay refusal within a run
fresh ticket validation immediately before every write
separate rollback tickets and partial-state receipt
limitations: An offline Penpot-only window cannot observe a cancellation issued after the last ticket was minted.
The embedded SHA-256 binding detects stale or corrupted inputs but is not a substitute for a trusted W0 signature verifier against a malicious operator.
W0 must stop issuing tickets on cancellation, use short expiry, and verify the capsule/ticket signatures before delivery.
forbidden_claim: A seeded local value is not treated as live cancellation authority.
